title: What is HisabDo?
text: HisabDo is an offline-first khata and ledger app for Android. It helps users track money given and received, customer balances, and expenses. PDF reports are available for supported records.
source: Official HisabDo FAQ — https://hisabdo.app/faq

title: How do I categorize an expense?
text: The existing FAQ describes expense categorization as a combination of rule-based matching and a machine-learning model. It states that uncertain predictions are flagged for the user to confirm or correct. Confirm this workflow against the current application before publishing.
source: Existing HisabDo FAQ; product confirmation required

title: Is my financial data used to train the shared AI model?
text: The existing FAQ states that individual users' raw financial data is not used as a chatbot knowledge source and that account-specific figures should come from the backend. Confirm the current data-handling and privacy policy with the product team before making this claim to users.
source: Existing HisabDo FAQ; privacy confirmation required

title: What is a cash flow statement?
text: A cash flow statement summarizes money entering and leaving a business during a period. It commonly groups cash flows into operating, investing, and financing activities.
source: OpenStax, Principles of Financial Accounting, Section 2.1 — https://openstax.org/books/principles-financial-accounting/pages/2-1-describe-the-income-statement-statement-of-owners-equity-balance-sheet-and-statement-of-cash-flows-and-how-they-interrelate

title: How do I export my expenses?
text: HisabDo supports PDF reports for supported records. Official documentation describes reports for transactions, customer balances, and customer activity. The exact steps may depend on the screen and record being viewed. CSV export is not confirmed by the source.
source: Official HisabDo FAQ — https://hisabdo.app/faq

title: What's the difference between profit and cash flow?
text: Profit is revenue minus expenses over a period under the applicable accounting rules. Cash flow describes actual cash entering and leaving a business. A business can report a profit while experiencing a cash shortage if customers have not paid.
source: OpenStax, Principles of Financial Accounting, Section 2.1 — https://openstax.org/books/principles-financial-accounting/pages/2-1-describe-the-income-statement-statement-of-owners-equity-balance-sheet-and-statement-of-cash-flows-and-how-they-interrelate

title: What is profit?
text: Profit is the amount remaining after expenses are subtracted from revenue, according to the applicable accounting method.
source: OpenStax, Principles of Financial Accounting, Section 2.1 — https://openstax.org/books/principles-financial-accounting/pages/2-1-describe-the-income-statement-statement-of-owners-equity-balance-sheet-and-statement-of-cash-flows-and-how-they-interrelate

title: What is revenue?
text: Revenue is the income generated from a business's sales or services before expenses are deducted.
source: OpenStax, Principles of Financial Accounting, Section 2.1 — https://openstax.org/books/principles-financial-accounting/pages/2-1-describe-the-income-statement-statement-of-owners-equity-balance-sheet-and-statement-of-cash-flows-and-how-they-interrelate

title: What is an expense?
text: An expense is a cost incurred by a business while operating or generating revenue.
source: OpenStax, Principles of Financial Accounting, Section 2.1 — https://openstax.org/books/principles-financial-accounting/pages/2-1-describe-the-income-statement-statement-of-owners-equity-balance-sheet-and-statement-of-cash-flows-and-how-they-interrelate

title: What is cash flow?
text: Cash flow is the movement of money into and out of a business during a period.
source: OpenStax, Principles of Financial Accounting, Section 2.1 — https://openstax.org/books/principles-financial-accounting/pages/2-1-describe-the-income-statement-statement-of-owners-equity-balance-sheet-and-statement-of-cash-flows-and-how-they-interrelate

title: Why should customer balances be tracked?
text: Tracking customer balances helps a business monitor outstanding payments and amounts owed by customers.
source: Existing finance FAQ; review required

title: Why should business expenses be categorized?
text: Categorizing business expenses makes financial records easier to analyze and helps identify where money is being spent.
source: Existing finance FAQ; review required

title: What is the difference between revenue and profit?
text: Revenue is the income generated before expenses are deducted. Profit is what remains after the relevant expenses are subtracted from revenue.
source: OpenStax, Principles of Financial Accounting, Section 2.1 — https://openstax.org/books/principles-financial-accounting/pages/2-1-describe-the-income-statement-statement-of-owners-equity-balance-sheet-and-statement-of-cash-flows-and-how-they-interrelate

title: Why can a profitable business have cash-flow problems?
text: A business may record revenue before receiving payment from customers. It can therefore report a profit while not having enough available cash to pay its immediate obligations.
source: OpenStax, Principles of Financial Accounting, Section 2.1 — https://openstax.org/books/principles-financial-accounting/pages/2-1-describe-the-income-statement-statement-of-owners-equity-balance-sheet-and-statement-of-cash-flows-and-how-they-interrelate

title: What is an outstanding customer payment?
text: An outstanding customer payment is an amount a customer still owes the business for goods or services already supplied.
source: New FAQ draft; review required

title: Why is it important to keep financial records?
text: Keeping organized financial records helps a business review income and expenses, monitor payments, and prepare financial summaries. The exact reports available depend on the business's tools and accounting practices.
source: New FAQ draft; review required

title: How do I download a financial report in HisabDo?
text: HisabDo supports PDF reports for supported records. Official documentation describes reports for transactions, customer balances, and customer activity. The exact steps may depend on the screen and record being viewed. CSV export is not confirmed by the source.
source: Official HisabDo FAQ — https://hisabdo.app/faq

title: How does HisabDo protect account-specific financial answers?
text: The intended design is that a user's personal balance, revenue, and expense figures must come from authorized backend data rather than general FAQ documents. Confirm the implementation and access controls with the engineering team before describing this as a guaranteed product behavior.
source: Product documentation draft; engineering confirmation required

title: What should the assistant do when it cannot find a relevant answer?
text: The assistant should avoid inventing product features or financial facts. When the knowledge base does not contain sufficiently relevant verified information, it should use the configured safe fallback and clearly avoid presenting unsupported details as facts.
source: Product documentation draft; engineering review required
